browser.environment: Google Chrome, actual WebGL 2 floating-point render targets
browser.test_storage: isolated in-memory storage; original storage unchanged

limits: Screen dimensions and viewing distance require user calibration.
Optical PSF and display tone response are editable approximations, not measured eye calibration.
Atmospheric and visibility estimates use Earth-inspired empirical models; not validated Terrax weather.
Partial disk and subpixel rendering have finite sampling error.
Screen-space optical blur is approximate at wide field angles and clipped at viewport edges.
Original orbital approximations remain; no precision multi-body ephemeris or lunar eclipse model.
Original generation and PNG tests were not rerun because those modules were not changed.
